name: corridor-weather
description: Unofficial open-source prober and public dashboard for Atum quote corridors. Not an official Atum product.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:dashboard && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:dashboard && node scripts/render-deploy-config.mjs && node .github/scripts/assert-testnet.mjs wrangler.deploy.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply corridor-weather --remote --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
